title: Modest Threads: exchange-rate case
subject: Business
unit: Spring 1: The international economy and government (1.5, 1.6)
source: Written for business/y10 lesson 29 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Modest Threads exchange-rate case)
intro: Lesson 29. Read the case and use the data in your answers. Remember SPICED: a Strong Pound makes Imports Cheaper and Exports Dearer.

passage.title: Modest Threads exports and imports
paras: Modest Threads sells abayas to customers in the USA through its website, at £50 each. Last month it sold 400 abayas there. American customers pay in dollars.
It buys its fabric from a mill in Turkey. The mill charges in euros: €6,000 a month.
This month the pound has strengthened against both currencies.
passage.source: All businesses, people and figures in this case are fictional, made up for practice.

questions.q: Calculate the dollar price of one abaya last month and this month.
Calculate the monthly cost of fabric in pounds last month and this month, and the change.
In the portal box, analyse the overall effect on Modest Threads' profit of the stronger pound. (6)
questions.a: Exports dearer: the abaya rises from $62.50 to $75, so US sales may fall below 400 a month, cutting revenue. Imports cheaper: fabric costs fall by £1,000 a month, raising the margin on every abaya. Net effect depends on how price-sensitive US customers are and on the share of sales abroad against imported costs.
